title: Virtual Reference Feedback Tuning
text: Automatically tune linearly parameterized controllers based on input-output data, 3 inputs, 1 output, {Weighting Function} sets Weighting function; {Sample time (Ts)}, {Reference Model} sets the reference model tf, {Controller Structure}, {Type} sets the pID controller type, {Integrator Method} sets the discrete integration method, {FIR Filter Order}, {SISO Linear Systems Ci(z)} sets the array of SISO linear systems tf and {Show θ values while tuning} sets the output tuned parameter values. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Reference Model
params.values: Reference model tf(1,[3 1]) (default) | tf model object | ss model object | zpk model object

params.name: Weighting Function
params.values: Weighting function 1 (default) | tf model object | ss model object | zpk model object

params.name: Controller Structure
params.values: Controller structure PID (default) | FIR Filter | Generic Form

params.name: Type
params.values: PID controller type PI (default) | P | I | PD | PID

params.name: Integrator Method
params.values: Discrete integration method Forward Euler (default) | Backward Euler | Trapezoidal

params.name: FIR Filter Order
params.values: FIR filter order 2 (default) | positive integer between 2 and 10

params.name: SISO Linear Systems Ci(z)
params.values: Array of SISO linear systems {tf([1],[1],0.1);0.1*tf([1],[1 -1],0.1)} (default) | cell array | LTI model array

params.name: Show θ values while tuning
params.values: Output tuned parameter values on (default) | off
